_note: Consolidated from 25 per-SKU regions into 4 shelf-level bands. The 3D GLB is a single fused mesh so per-product raycasting isn't possible, and the shelf sways constantly — small precise rects miss more than they hit. Each region below covers a whole shelf tier so hover tooltips land reliably even with drift.
